{{Top|leg}}
The '''LE-8 sensor dampener''' was produced by [[Santhe Corporation/Legends|Santhe Corporation]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed for use in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], it dampened nearby enemies' sensors by a jamming signal that "piggybacked" on a target's sensor scans.
